rule: every ledger entry is stamped with the turn whose closing snapshot holds its cash: the processing turn inside processTurn, otherwise gameState.currentTurn + 1

qualification.acceptance: wire between two snapshots: rows keep turn 0, entries land in turn 5, zero divergence
qualification.redWithBaseEmitter: acceptance case fails (entries stay at turn 0)

cost: none inside a turn; one projected gameState read per emission batch or journal plan outside a turn
limits: No production database was reset or repaired.
